profile.name: INHECO堆叠式孵育振荡器
profile.description: 这是一种可堆叠的实验室孵育振荡设备，用于微孔板等样品载具的控温孵育与振荡混匀。设备具有装载抽屉或托盘、温度控制和二维振荡功能，适用于细胞培养、样品孵育、反应混匀及自动化工作站中的板式处理流程。
profile.description_en: A stackable laboratory incubator shaker for temperature-controlled incubation and shaking of microplates and similar sample carriers. It includes a loading drawer or tray, temperature regulation, and two-axis shaking, and is used for cell culture, sample incubation, reaction mixing, and plate-based workflows in automated lab systems.
